title: MemoryOrb
description: A unit of compressed cognitive continuity. SKELETON: this fixes the required envelope fields so consolidation_event references (input_orbs, output_orbs, previous_versions) have a stable target. The detailed schema (core structure, halo cursor, tether shape) lands in pr-1.0/orb-schema.

kind.description: The species of orb. system_root is the original RootOrb generalized; the rest are user-domain specializations. New kinds require a schema migration.

core_version.description: Monotonically increasing. Each successful consolidation produces a new core_version.

core.description: Dense, compressed claims. Detailed in pr-1.0.

halo_ref.description: Cursor/query into the event log defining the orb's halo. Detailed in pr-1.1.

tethers.description: Typed graph edges to other orbs. Detailed in pr-1.2.

ancestors.description: Orb ids whose lineage this orb descends from (for merged or branched orbs).

privileged.description: If true, the halo cannot be compressed without an ATTESTATION event covering the consolidation. Enforced by luna-govern at runtime.

policy_bindings.description: Optional governance rule references that participate in this orb's resonance.
